description: VB-CABLE virtual audio device: routes application audio output into a recordable input. Donationware.
notes: SYSTEM DRIVER. Requires administrator rights and a reboot after installation.
The installer is run automatically. If it fails, run VBCABLE_Setup_x64.exe from the app directory as administrator.
Uninstall by running the same setup and choosing Remove Driver, not by 'scoop uninstall'.
